title: Nice bag.  Well made.
text: Nice bag.  Well made.. Cute bag.  It's well made and the colors and design can go with nearly everything!  Great beach or pool bag.  It's large enough to hold a couple of beach towels, plus your other sunning needs!  It's well made and seems like it will last for years.

description: This is the PERFECT bag for a day at the beach, pool, picnic, or gym to carry all your personal belonging such as towels, water bottles, glasses, sunblock or whatever you need. The durable, yet lightweight cotton & polyester material blend allows sand, dirt, and water to fall off the bag so it stays where it belongs. The comfortable straps and webbing around the top edges and pockets prevent scratching or poking you, making it easy to carry wherever you’re going. Large totes are available in a variety of styles.
